verdict.rationale: Beamer's homepage claims webhooks are available alongside its API and integrations, so the product appears to offer this capability itself. That claim is a single marketing line with no documentation of event types, how to register endpoints, payload formats, or delivery behavior. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration for programmatic consumers, a list of subscribable events, payload/schema and retry/signing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
